music.yandex_step1: 1. Open the login page and sign in to your Yandex account.
music.yandex_step2: 2. After signing in, copy the page address from the browser (it contains access_token=...) and paste it here:
music.yandex_note: Unofficial method, same as the mobile app. The token is stored only on your computer: config/blockphone/accounts.json — never share it. Without Yandex Plus only previews play.
music.spotify_step1: 1. Create your own app in Spotify for Developers (Create app, Web API).
music.spotify_step2: 2. Add this address to Redirect URIs (click to copy):
music.spotify_step3: 3. Paste the app's Client ID here and press “Connect” — a browser will open.
music.spotify_note: Music plays in Spotify itself (on your computer or phone); the in-game phone is a remote. Control requires Spotify Premium.
